changes.description: Road club with four groups rolling every Saturday morning, and Sunday too. A and B groups hold 19 to 23+ mph; B and C are no-drop double pacelines; the D group is for newer road riders and covers skills and rules of the road. Rides end at a coffee shop in Seal Beach.
changes.visitor_notes: The club's Meetup post calls the C-Group a good ride for a strong cyclist to try the group out. Sign the ride waiver on the club's site. The start is the Marina Dr lot, not the Eldorado Park library lot, until the construction ends (club notice dated May 2026).

changes.description: The Sunday club ride of one of LA's oldest and largest cycling clubs, known as the World Famous Nichols Ride. Hard pace with racers in the group, and turnout of 40 to over 100. The club suggests newer riders try one of its easier weekday rides first. Open to non-members. Helmets, lights when dark, no aero bars, no earphones.

changes.description: Weekly Monday-night road ride out of Incycle Pasadena, going since 2007. The pace runs medium to hard, but the group regroups at major turns and at the top of long climbs. The route changes every week and is posted on the club's Strava page. Bring lights, tools, a tube and water.
